
```{r}
library(scspill)

# パッケージ内のテスト補助スクリプトを再利用
# （インストール後は system.file で取得可能）
helper <- system.file("tests/testthat/helper-sim.R", package = "scspill")
source(helper)

set.seed(1)
sim <- gen_sim(N = 36, T = 30, T0 = 20, rho = 0.3)

fit <- sc_spillover(sim$panel, treated_unit = "T0", T0 = sim$T0,
                    w = sim$w, W = sim$W,
                    M = 1000, burn = 500, seed = 1, verbose = FALSE)
summary(fit)
```


```{r}
plot(fit, type = "treated")
```
